purpose: The pilot population of WO-EVI-05: the families of the WO-FAM-01 cut, the kit rule 4 axes each declares in its own Modern skin, the axes a reviewed semantic-identity exclusion withdrew (published as NOT APPLICABLE with the reason, never as moved), and the catalog and exclusion revisions the pilot run was measured at. Pilot denominators only; a fleet claim may not cite them. Read as applicable/denominator PLUS the N/A beside it: shape is 4 applicable + 1 N/A, never 5 and never 4/4 alone.

shape.reason: semantic identity: the indicator is round because round means single-choice, and the dot is bound to the indicator. The bare radio stamps no frame part for a corner to govern, its focus ring is an outline and its touch target is a height, which kit rule 4 does not count as shape. No shape decision may lawfully move these two radii without breaking what the control means.
